detail_observations.label: Description
detail_observations.text: Enorian says, "The device I'll give you is broken, probably because it was buried in Zoth Uluus' mud for centuries in the Leth Verael ruins." "I dug it up years ago, and cleaned it up some. I believe the unicorns of Leth Verael worked with the high elves to develop and use these devices. Perhaps they'd teleport unicorns across the city to get from one garden to another." "Regardless, I think Ardalan Awji can get this device working again. He lives in Mekalia, but in the mountains; not in the city."

detail_observations.label: Another account
detail_observations.text:
Walkthrough as recorded by vgwalkthroughs 1. The Broken Device
   Enorian Andowyn ends up giving you a teleportation device that is broken. He dug it up in the Leth Verael ruins a while back, and was broken when he found it. He tells you about a guy that he knows named Ardalan Awji, who lives in the mountains in Qalia, by the city of Mekalia. The fastest way there would be to take the riftway to Qa Riverbank, and head one chunk east on the back of a wyvern. Ardalan Awji is located in the mountains and should be easy to find, especially since you have a mark on your map that leads directly to him.
   When you make it to Ardalan Awji he instantly gives you a new Allegiance Saddlebag, which is a 22 slot saddlebag, and most likely will replace the one that you have on (woohoo, you can collect more junk now!).
   Quest: Question and Answer
   Ardalan Awji seems willing to fix the device for you, and says that it would be a challenge worthy of his wit. Unfortunately he needs Arcane Pliers to complete the job, but he doesn't have it to fix the device, but he does know somebody who does named Azeeta Shaheen. Now the tool costs 10 gold to get (yup GOLD!), so I hope you have a lot of cash to burn. Azeeta Shaheen is located one chunk south in the chunk of Zossyr Hakrel. Watch out for mobs as you run through this chunk as there are many mobs in the low 30s (2dot) that will attack you, but once you do make it to Azeeta Shaheen, it is just a matter of purchasing the Pliers and heading back to Ardalan Awji for the turn in.
2. The Device Works!
   Your Unicorn Teleporter is now in full working condition! All you have to do is right click the device to find the last remaining lost Unicorn. When you do right click it, a point on your map will appear on the northern portion of Thestra, of a unicorn by the name of Aynien.
   There is no easy way to travel to Aynien and the only way I can suggest would be to take the riftway to Three Rivers, and fly as far as you can go to Aynien (she is marked on your map. She is located three chunks to the north and two chunks to the west on a small island. When you get there, watch out for mobs that are also on the island.
3. The Last Unicorn
   When you make it to Aynien you inform her that you have a device that will teleport her away from this island. She is skeptical of the device and wants to examine it over before she uses it. While she is examining it she would like you to kill a few of the Seadredges and Kelpwalkers that lurk around the island, 15 Seadredges and 25 Kelpwalkers to be exact! Both mobs are around level 30 3dot and are not only wandering around the island, but are also wandering in the water. In fact there won't be enough mobs to kill on land, that you will be forced to either wait for respawn or find them in the water.
   After all 40 mobs are killed go back to Aynien where she agrees to use the Unicorn Teleporter. She has attuned the device to her and needs you to use the device on her so she can get teleported. She also tells you to return to Myrthion (the very first unicorn!) and explain to him that all the unicorns have been reunited!
   So you can right click the device on Aynien and start your long journey back to Myrthion. I recommend recalling back to civilization and taking your nearest riftway back to Silverlake. Take a Griffon from there and fly north until you reach Myrthion (he is marked on your map). You find Myrithion in the exact same place where you left him, and he is extremely excited that you have found all of the lost unicorns! In fact he is so excited that he offers you a Unicorn Mount! (FINALLY!)
   Now there will be a bunch of different Unicorns that you can choose from, each of them have the same stats and the only difference would be that they have different color saddles. Your choices of colors are Forest-Colored, Amber, Black, Sky-Colored, Green, and Blue. So pick your favorite color and there you have it, your very own Unicorn Mount! Now go gallop around the world on your glorious steed, and show off your new pet!
   Part 1 - Zar the "not-so" Mighty
   Required Level: 21The Unicorn Horn
   Part 2 - Adaenyl's Bidding
   Required Level: 23Aeokor Hunting
   Part 3 - Medratheda's Bidding
   Required Level: 24Let's Make Some Lizard Stew.
   Part 4 - The Shrine Divine
   Required Level: 25The Raging Brownies
   Protection from Ashendregs
   Look at the Size of That Bird!
   Part 5 - Wardship Troubles
   Required Level: 28Locating Another Unicorn
   Part 6 - Down the Last Stretch
   Required Level: 30The Broken Device http://www.vgwalkthroughs.com:80/page/parts/18

pages.article_html:
A Marvelous Plan

Level 29 · Adventuring · Wardship Of The Sleeping Moon · Thestra

Take the broken unicorn teleporter to Ardalan Awji at the Upper Upside Camp in Mekalia, in Qalia. See if he can fix the device.

Objectives

- Broken Unicorn Teleporter (0/1)

Description

Enorian says, "The device I'll give you is broken, probably because it was buried in Zoth Uluus' mud for centuries in the Leth Verael ruins." "I dug it up years ago, and cleaned it up some. I believe the unicorns of Leth Verael worked with the high elves to develop and use these devices. Perhaps they'd teleport unicorns across the city to get from one garden to another." "Regardless, I think Ardalan Awji can get this device working again. He lives in Mekalia, but in the mountains; not in the city."

What they say

On offering it

Enorian
The device I'll give you is broken, probably because it was buried in Zoth Uluus' mud for centuries in the Leth Verael ruins. I dug it up years ago, and cleaned it up some. I believe the unicorns of Leth Verael worked with the high elves to develop and use these devices. Perhaps they'd teleport unicorns across the city to get from one garden to another. Regardless, I think Ardalan Awji can get this device working again. He lives in Mekalia, but in the mountains; not in the city.

Recorded by quest description.

Another account

Someone who played this quest wrote down how they did it. That is a different thing from the quest’s own text — where the NPC stands, which mob drops the piece — and the archive holds it for almost nothing else.

Walkthrough as recorded by vgwalkthroughs

1. The Broken Device Enorian Andowyn ends up giving you a teleportation device that is broken. He dug it up in the Leth Verael ruins a while back, and was broken when he found it. He tells you about a guy that he knows named Ardalan Awji, who lives in the mountains in Qalia, by the city of Mekalia. The fastest way there would be to take the riftway to Qa Riverbank, and head one chunk east on the back of a wyvern. Ardalan Awji is located in the mountains and should be easy to find, especially since you have a mark on your map that leads directly to him. When you make it to Ardalan Awji he instantly gives you a new Allegiance Saddlebag, which is a 22 slot saddlebag, and most likely will replace the one that you have on (woohoo, you can collect more junk now!). Quest: Question and Answer Ardalan Awji seems willing to fix the device for you, and says that it would be a challenge worthy of his wit. Unfortunately he needs Arcane Pliers to complete the job, but he doesn't have it to fix the device, but he does know somebody who does named Azeeta Shaheen. Now the tool costs 10 gold to get (yup GOLD!), so I hope you have a lot of cash to burn. Azeeta Shaheen is located one chunk south in the chunk of Zossyr Hakrel. Watch out for mobs as you run through this chunk as there are many mobs in the low 30s (2dot) that will attack you, but once you do make it to Azeeta Shaheen, it is just a matter of purchasing the Pliers and heading back to Ardalan Awji for the turn in. 2. The Device Works! Your Unicorn Teleporter is now in full working condition! All you have to do is right click the device to find the last remaining lost Unicorn. When you do right click it, a point on your map will appear on the northern portion of Thestra, of a unicorn by the name of Aynien. There is no easy way to travel to Aynien and the only way I can suggest would be to take the riftway to Three Rivers, and fly as far as you can go to Aynien (she is marked on your map. She is located three chunks to the north and two chunks to the west on a small island. When you get there, watch out for mobs that are also on the island. 3. The Last Unicorn When you make it to Aynien you inform her that you have a device that will teleport her away from this island. She is skeptical of the device and wants to examine it over before she uses it. While she is examining it she would like you to kill a few of the Seadredges and Kelpwalkers that lurk around the island, 15 Seadredges and 25 Kelpwalkers to be exact! Both mobs are around level 30 3dot and are not only wandering around the island, but are also wandering in the water. In fact there won't be enough mobs to kill on land, that you will be forced to either wait for respawn or find them in the water. After all 40 mobs are killed go back to Aynien where she agrees to use the Unicorn Teleporter. She has attuned the device to her and needs you to use the device on her so she can get teleported. She also tells you to return to Myrthion (the very first unicorn!) and explain to him that all the unicorns have been reunited! So you can right click the device on Aynien and start your long journey back to Myrthion. I recommend recalling back to civilization and taking your nearest riftway back to Silverlake. Take a Griffon from there and fly north until you reach Myrthion (he is marked on your map). You find Myrithion in the exact same place where you left him, and he is extremely excited that you have found all of the lost unicorns! In fact he is so excited that he offers you a Unicorn Mount! (FINALLY!) Now there will be a bunch of different Unicorns that you can choose from, each of them have the same stats and the only difference would be that they have different color saddles. Your choices of colors are Forest-Colored, Amber, Black, Sky-Colored, Green, and Blue. So pick your favorite color and there you have it, your very own Unicorn Mount! Now go gallop around the world on your glorious steed, and show off your new pet! findings.observation: The primary tracker prints Broken Unicorn Teleporter (0/1). The fandom-attributed account prints Broken Unicorn Teleporter (1) and the summary directs taking it to Ardalan Awji at Upper Upside Camp in Mekalia, Qalia. Preserve one requested object without inferring acquisition, consumption or repair scripts.

Starts with is Enorian Andowyn; Hand in to is Ardalan Awji. Details print 6088, -12465, 10324 in Wardship of the Sleeping Moon (-23, 25). These coordinates occur with the starting location, not a verified Ardalan spawn. Dialogue says he lives in the Mekalia mountains rather than the city.

Rewards list three separate fragments: 22 Slots; Allegiance Saddlebags (Container; mount). The vgwalkthroughs-attributed walkthrough describes a singular Allegiance Saddlebag with 22 slots given by Ardalan upon arrival. Retain both spellings and fragmentation; do not synthesize three reward items or assign an unverified item identity.

The walkthrough continues into Question and Answer, describing Arcane Pliers purchased from Azeeta Shaheen for 10 gold, then device use, Aynien and kills of 15 Seadredges and 25 Kelpwalkers. These are attributed later-chain observations, not the primary objective or monetary reward of A Marvelous Plan. No canonical targets, merchant inventory or operative prices are established.

The same walkthrough describes a later return to Myrthion, also spelled Myrithion, and a unicorn mount choice with Forest-Colored, Amber, Black, Sky-Colored, Green and Blue saddles. It claims matching stats without giving them. Do not attach those terminal-chain rewards or invented mount statistics to this quest.
